description: Show what changed in a diagram's infrastructure. Without `version`, returns the pull-request delta for a PR-branch diagram: resources added, removed and changed compared with the base branch. With `version` (a timestamp from list_versions), compares that version with the one before it, or with the latest parse when `against` is "live".

graphId.description: The diagram's graphId, as list_diagrams or get_diagram returns it. The id start_parse returned also works.

name: get_delta
title: Get an infrastructure delta
